history: regressed: fails on all 18 SM 6.6-capable stable releases, but the symptom changed from a diagnostic (v1.6.2104-v1.6.2112) to an internal compiler error (v1.7.2207 onward); v1.4.1907 and v1.5.2010 predate the feature and cannot answer
summary: Member call on a cast ResourceDescriptorHeap subscript no longer produces the reported diagnostic: since v1.7.2207 DXC exits 0x80AA001D with 'Internal Compiler error: llvm::cast<X>() argument of incompatible type!' from LowerGetResourceFromHeap. Cast-to-local, cast-as-argument and the 2021 workaround all compile clean.
text_stale: Body: the diagnostic quoted in the issue has not been emitted by any release since v1.7.2207; the input now fails with an internal compiler error and no source location. The 2021-11-08 comment reasons about that diagnostic and so describes behaviour that no longer exists.
title: Odd compiliation error with ResourceDescriptorHeap and type deduction
